title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the total electric charge q.

title: Circuit Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up the circuit equation involving emf, resistance, and self-inductance.

title: Magnetic Flux Change
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize the relationship between changing magnetic flux and induced emf.

title: Integration Step
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly perform the integration step to relate charge and magnetic flux.

title: Units Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student should verify that the units of the final answer are consistent and correct.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the circuit equations.

title: Neglecting L's Role
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not incorrectly assert that self-inductance L has no effect on the charge q.
